no-restricted-syntax.message: `let` is not supported in Adobe AIR 32. Use `var` (or top-level `const`).
Arrow functions are not supported in Adobe AIR 32. Use `function () { ... }`.
Template literals are not supported in Adobe AIR 32. Use string concatenation.
Tagged templates are not supported in Adobe AIR 32.
Spread (`...`) is not supported in Adobe AIR 32. Use Array.prototype.slice / Function.prototype.apply.
Rest parameters (`...args`) are not supported in Adobe AIR 32. Use `arguments`.
Destructuring is not supported in Adobe AIR 32. Use explicit property access.
Destructuring is not supported in Adobe AIR 32. Use explicit index access.
`class` is not supported in Adobe AIR 32. Use prototype-based constructors.
`class` is not supported in Adobe AIR 32. Use prototype-based constructors.
ES modules are not supported in Adobe AIR 32. Use IIFE attaching to the `Steward` namespace.
ES modules are not supported in Adobe AIR 32.
ES modules are not supported in Adobe AIR 32.
`for...of` is not supported in Adobe AIR 32. Use a numeric `for` loop or `$.each`.
`.includes()` is not supported in Adobe AIR 32. Use `.indexOf(x) > -1`.
`.startsWith()` is not supported in Adobe AIR 32. Use `.indexOf(x) === 0`.
`.endsWith()` is not supported in Adobe AIR 32.
`.find()` is not supported in Adobe AIR 32. Use a `for` loop or `.filter()[0]`.
`.findIndex()` is not supported in Adobe AIR 32.
`.padStart()` is not supported in Adobe AIR 32.
`.padEnd()` is not supported in Adobe AIR 32.
`String.prototype.repeat()` is not reliably supported in Adobe AIR 32.
`Set` is not supported in Adobe AIR 32. Use a plain object as a key map.
`Map` is not supported in Adobe AIR 32. Use a plain object.
`WeakSet` is not supported in Adobe AIR 32.
`WeakMap` is not supported in Adobe AIR 32.
`Promise` is not supported in Adobe AIR 32. Use callbacks/responders.
`await` is not supported in Adobe AIR 32.
`async` functions are not supported in Adobe AIR 32.
`async` functions are not supported in Adobe AIR 32.
